scope: Warm component queries, not complete decompilation or IDA/radare2 comparison. Identical inputs, Release, alternating process order, seven pairs. Other users' builds were present; no own builds, runtime tests or profilers overlapped timing. A lightweight format/diff check overlapped the start of the Clang primitive campaign; owner and GCC campaigns did not overlap it.
baseline: Matched harness/build settings/dependency commits. The owner baseline uses the original three std::binary_search calls; all candidate result vectors are independently checked against std::lower_bound. Setup/index construction is untimed and storage/construction are unchanged.
limitations: Tiny scalar controls have measurable admission/check overhead. Gains are workload-dependent; some ordered controls regress.
Hardware counters were unavailable (perf_event_paranoid=4). No global kernel, cache or governor settings changed.
ARM64 QEMU is correctness evidence only. Native Windows/macOS and Linux ARM64 CI results are pending; no native speed claim for them.
dependency_policy: scripts/build.py refreshed all five remote default branches for every build; no pinned/local source override of these forks.

inputs.real_input: llvm23.bin dynamic defined function symbols; 50% exact addresses, 50% +1 queries; synthetic query traces, not a recorded execution trace
